Metadata.Title: Gravity Rush Remastered (Gravity Daze)
Metadata.Name: GPU memory pool 4 GB (needs extra_dmem_in_mbytes 2048)
Metadata.Note: DRAFT, UNTESTED in game; emulator only. Raises the game GPU memory pool from 3 GB to 4095 MB, the largest size its 32-bit pool code accepts. Set extra_dmem_in_mbytes to 2048 under General in the emulator config.json (or the per-game CUSA01130.json), or the game cannot start. For a Resolution, Ultrawide or 16:10 toggle that runs out of GPU memory; the toggles that need it already carry the same line.
Metadata.Author: Junmin Lee
